subject: maths
question: Under a sale offer, Suresh was offered 20% discount on the part of the marked price that was paid in cash, but was charged 0.5% on the part marked price paid through a credit card. If Suresh paid 40% of the marked price in cash and the rest through a credit card, what percentage of the marked price was his total final payment?
solution: Given: Discount % = 20% on the part of the Marked price that was paid in cash Charged 0.5% on the part marked price paid through a credit card Suresh paid 40% of the marked price in cash and the rest through a credit card Formula Used: Discount % = Marked Price × Discount Rate
